name: media-parser-worker
description: 多平台媒体解析工具 - Cloudflare Worker (ParserFactory架构)

scripts.build:dist: npm run build && npm run copy:dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build:dist && node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='../dash';try{f.rmSync(p,{recursive:true})}catch(e){}f.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true});f.cpSync('dist','../dash',{recursive:true});console.log('部署文件已准备到 dash/ 目录');f.readdirSync('dist').forEach(fn=>console.log('  - '+fn))"
